name: test_provider_connection
title: Test provider connection
description: Explicitly check the saved connection's current credential and provider metadata after expected_revision validation. This observational operation may update authentication/catalog check timestamps but not configuration revision, enabled state, keys, model verification, model selection, generation history or meeting content. It never sends meetings, starts generation, prompts for login, reads ambient keys or switches providers. Use only the validated endpoint and configured API surface, with no redirect, proxy, protocol, token-field or endpoint fallback. A safe failure result may set connected=false and retain the connection for correction; transport/authentication prerequisites may return an error. Metadata success is not proof that generation works. In particular, OpenAI-compatible API and Claude Agent SDK models stay unverified until the user separately calls verify_provider_model with the charge confirmation. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: invalid_argument, not_found, configuration_conflict, authentication_required, engine_unavailable, internal. All provider operations require the authenticated resident server; no implicit in-process or unauthenticated HTTP fallback is allowed.
